headline: This Switch 2 sequel accessory was a few millimeters away from being good
summary: The Crkd Nitro Deck 2 was designed for both original Switch and the upcoming Switch 2. It offers Hall effect sticks, addressing common Joy-Con drift issues. Despite improvements, it's just shy of being perfect for the new console.

headline: Now you can watch Instagram Reels on your Apple TV
summary: Instagram has expanded to Apple TV, allowing users to watch video content on a bigger screen. This includes Reels, live streams, and other video formats. The feature follows testing from last December and new updates in June.

headline: r/opensource just banned AI, non-English speakers, and more
summary: The r/opensource subreddit has introduced strict new submission rules. Projects using or made by AI are now explicitly banned from the community. Non-English speakers are also reportedly affected by these controversial changes.

headline: Google’s AI search changes upended online publishing
summary: Google's recent AI-driven search updates have caused significant disruption in digital publishing. The industry, heavily reliant on search traffic, faces an overhaul in content visibility. Publishers are now adapting to a new era of AI-influenced web presence.

headline: Rumored Lucia Actress Goes Viral After Dodging Swarm of GTA 6 Comments During Livestream
summary: Manni L. Perez, rumored actress for GTA 6's Lucia, recently went viral. She skillfully dodged a barrage of Grand Theft Auto 6 questions during a livestream. The incident highlights intense fan anticipation for the upcoming game.

headline: Man Arrested for Brandishing Knife at Crew on the Set of Miami Vice ‘85
summary: A man was arrested in Brooklyn for threatening crew members on the 'Miami Vice '85' set. The 23-year-old, Alex Perez, allegedly brandished a knife. Police officers working security on the set made the arrest.

headline: New Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Pokes Fun at Multiple 'Captains America'
summary: Marvel released a new 'Avengers: Doomsday' trailer showcasing Thor and Steve Rogers' dynamic. The trailer humorously touches on their shared worthiness to wield Mjolnir. It playfully highlights the concept of multiple Captain Americas in the universe.

headline: James Gunn Defends the DCU's Approach to Interconnected Stories, Doesn't Want Movies Like Clayface to Exist Just to 'Set Up' Crossovers
summary: DC Studios co-chairman James Gunn defended the DCU's approach to interconnected storytelling. He stated he doesn't want movies like Clayface to exist solely for crossover setups. Gunn emphasizes organic narrative development over forced franchise connections.

headline: Burnham open to 'honest discussion' on EU free movement
summary: The Prime Minister expressed openness to an 'honest discussion' regarding EU free movement. He called for a 'factual' and 'evidence-based debate' on the topic. The potential return to free movement between Britain and Europe is under consideration.

headline: Couple were celebrating anniversary before Bahamas tragedy
summary: Leanne Gregory tragically died in the Bahamas while attempting to save her sons. The family from Nottinghamshire was celebrating their anniversary at the time. Her children were swept out to sea, prompting her heroic rescue attempt.

headline: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
summary: María Machado, a prominent Venezuelan opposition leader, has returned to her country. Her return follows months spent in exile abroad. This development comes after the US government took action against President Nicolás Maduro.

headline: Why the charts are full of old songs - and so are your playlists
summary: Music charts and personal playlists are increasingly dominated by older songs. The article explores the reasons behind this resurgence of classic tracks. It questions why retro music is now outperforming many new releases.
